at 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix cli- --board-name 'Default board'
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: cli-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/default-list.jsonl
exec card --json board show
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/default-show.json

exec card --json board create 'Second board'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/second-create.json
exec card --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/two-boards.jsonl

# A board-wide mutation cannot guess after the store has two boards.
! exec card create 'Ambiguous issue'
! stdout .
stderr 'board selection is ambiguous'
! exec card list
! stdout .
stderr 'board selection is ambiguous'

exec card --json board use board_11111111111111111111
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/second-use.json
exec card create 'Second issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/second-issue.txt

exec card --json board edit --description 'Second board context.'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/second-description.json
exec card --json board show
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/second-description.json

# Explicit board selection overrides the checkout binding.
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 create 'Default issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/default-issue.txt
exec card --json board show board_00000000000000000000
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/default-show.json
exec card --json board edit board_00000000000000000000 --description 'Default board context.'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/default-description.json

# The explicit flag wins over CARDAMOM_BOARD, which wins over the binding.
env CARDAMOM_BOARD=board_00000000000000000000
exec card create 'Environment issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/environment-issue.txt
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 create 'Flag issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/flag-issue.txt
env CARDAMOM_BOARD=

# Board creation rejects an unknown explicit project selector.
! exec card board create --project missing 'Missing project board'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/missing-project.txt
